afternoon-swim.name: Afternoon Swim
afternoon-swim.short: A sun-drenched citrus aquatic: Sicilian orange, bergamot and mandarin with ginger and sea salt, on white musk.
afternoon-swim.wear: The ultimate hot-weather scent: summer days, beach trips and casual daytime wear. Spray generously.

pacific-chill.name: Pacific Chill
pacific-chill.short: A serene fruity aromatic: blackcurrant, citrus and mint, apricot, basil and May rose, on figs, dates and ambrette.
pacific-chill.wear: Clean and energising, like a morning wellness retreat. For spring and summer days.

hudson-valley.name: Hudson Valley
hudson-valley.short: A crisp woody aromatic: green leaves, bergamot and mountain air, pine and sage, on cedarwood, vetiver and musk.
hudson-valley.insp: The natural beauty and lush landscapes of the Hudson Valley.
hudson-valley.wear: Calming and versatile. For daily wear, outdoor excursions and lovers of green scents.

khamrah-dukhan.name: Khamrah Dukhan
khamrah-dukhan.short: A smoky spiced gourmand: cinnamon and nutmeg, dates, praline and tuberose, on amber, vanilla and smoky dukhan.
khamrah-dukhan.insp: The Khamrah line by Lattafa, with an added smoky, resinous twist.
khamrah-dukhan.wear: The ultimate cozy statement for cold weather, evenings and special gatherings.

vintage-charlie.name: Vintage Charlie
vintage-charlie.short: A nostalgic floral aldehyde: green notes, aldehydes and hyacinth, jasmine and orris, on oakmoss, sandalwood and musk.
vintage-charlie.wear: Clean and spirited with a classic charm. Wear it every day.

ombre-nomade.name: Ombre Nomade
ombre-nomade.short: A dark desert oud: benzoin and raspberry, agarwood, incense and saffron, on woody amber, leather and rose.
ombre-nomade.wear: Formidable yet wearable. For formal events, evenings and cold weather; one spray goes far.

tuscan-leather.name: Tuscan Leather
tuscan-leather.short: A raw, refined leather: raspberry, saffron and thyme, olibanum and jasmine, on leather, suede and amber.
tuscan-leather.wear: Commanding. A signature for evenings, formal events and statement style.

men-in-black.name: Men in Black
men-in-black.short: A seductive spicy amber: fiery spices, tobacco and rum, leather, iris and tuberose, on tonka, guaiac and benzoin.
men-in-black.wear: Magnetic and mysterious. For evenings, romantic dates and cold weather.

boss-bottled-elixir.name: Boss Bottled Elixir
boss-bottled-elixir.short: An intense woody amber: frankincense and cardamom, vetiver and patchouli, on labdanum and cedarwood.
boss-bottled-elixir.insp: BOSS Bottled Elixir by Hugo Boss.
boss-bottled-elixir.wear: Strength with subtlety. For work, evening engagements and refined everyday wear.

royal-miraj-vintage.name: Royal Miraj Vintage
royal-miraj-vintage.short: A classic spicy woody oriental: bergamot and lavender, clove, cinnamon and rose, on sandalwood, amber and musk.
royal-miraj-vintage.wear: Old-world and dignified. For formal gatherings, evenings and traditional occasions.

pasha.name: Pasha
pasha.short: A classic aromatic fougère: lavender, mandarin, mint and caraway, coriander and rosewood, on oakmoss and sandalwood.
pasha.wear: Polished and professional. A signature for the office and formal occasions.

black-opium-red.name: Black Opium Red
black-opium-red.short: A daring fruity gourmand: red mandarin, cherry and bergamot, white flowers and black coffee, on vanilla and cedar.
black-opium-red.insp: The Red editions of Black Opium by Yves Saint Laurent.
black-opium-red.wear: Bold and glamorous. For evenings, parties and special events.

issey-miyake-m.name: Issey Miyake M
issey-miyake-m.short: A clean aquatic woody: yuzu, bergamot and tarragon, water lily and nutmeg, on sandalwood, vetiver and tobacco.
issey-miyake-m.insp: L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme by Issey Miyake.
issey-miyake-m.wear: A gold standard of freshness. For daytime, work and hot summer weather.

aqua-kiss.name: Aqua Kiss
aqua-kiss.desc: Aqua Kiss is a mild, fresh fragrance for women. Sea notes, freesia and aloe vera open with a cool splash, soft daisy and chamomile follow, and a sweet heart of plum blossom leaves a light, clean trail.
aqua-kiss.short: A mild, fresh scent for women: sea notes, freesia and aloe vera with a sweet heart of plum blossom.
aqua-kiss.wear: Light and easy. Spray freely for daytime, college and warm days; reapply in the afternoon.

gentleman-society.name: Gentleman Society
gentleman-society.desc: Gentleman Society is a refined woody fragrance for men. Nutmeg, peppermint and clary sage open crisply, a heart of coffee, orris and vetiver with French narcissus adds depth, and Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood and Himalayan cedar finish it smoothly.
gentleman-society.short: A refined woody for men: nutmeg, peppermint and sage over coffee, orris and vetiver, on vanilla and sandalwood.
gentleman-society.insp: Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême by Givenchy.
gentleman-society.wear: Elegant and warm. For evenings, formal occasions and cooler months.

3-piece-perfume-combo.name: 3-Piece Perfume Combo
3-piece-perfume-combo.desc:
Experience luxury in every spray with the Saudagar Perfumers Premium 3-Piece Perfume Combo. This exclusive collection includes three signature fragrances (Oud & Lavender, Blue 7 and Magic), carefully crafted to suit every mood and occasion.

Formulated with 50% perfume oil concentration, these Extrait de Parfum fragrances deliver an intense, rich aroma with exceptional long-lasting performance. Whether you’re heading to work, a party or a special occasion, this premium collection keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day.

Why you’ll love it

  • 3 premium signature fragrances
  • 50% perfume oil concentration
  • Long-lasting performance
  • Rich, luxurious fragrance experience
3-piece-perfume-combo.short: Three Saudagar signature Extrait de Parfum fragrances (Oud & Lavender, Blue 7 and Magic) with 50% perfume oil.
3-piece-perfume-combo.insp: Three Saudagar signatures in one box, so there is a scent for work, parties and special occasions.
3-piece-perfume-combo.wear: Pick the bottle for the moment: Blue 7 for fresh daytime wear, Oud & Lavender for evenings, Magic for parties.
3-piece-perfume-combo.cn: Extrait de Parfum · 50% perfume oil · 3 bottles

red-tobacco.name: Red Tobacco
red-tobacco.desc: Red Tobacco is a rich, smoky oriental. Cinnamon, saffron and incense open with green apple and white peach, patchouli and jasmine warm the heart, and it settles on tobacco, oud, amber, vanilla and sandalwood.
red-tobacco.short: A rich smoky oriental: cinnamon, saffron and incense over patchouli and jasmine, on tobacco, oud and vanilla.
red-tobacco.wear: Bold and long lasting. For cold evenings and special occasions; one or two sprays.

burmi-oud-2.name: Burmi Oud
burmi-oud-2.desc: Burmi Oud is a deep, traditional oud built around Burmese agarwood. Saffron and rose open warmly over the smoky, slightly sweet oud, and amber with sandalwood gives a long, rich finish.
burmi-oud-2.short: A deep traditional oud: Burmese agarwood with saffron and rose, on amber and sandalwood.
burmi-oud-2.insp: Burmese oud, prized in Arabian perfumery for its smoky sweetness.
burmi-oud-2.wear: Rich and lasting. For evenings, prayers and festive occasions; a little goes a long way.

yal-y.name: Yal Y
yal-y.desc: Yal Y is a fresh, confident aromatic fragrance for men. Crisp apple, ginger and bergamot open brightly, sage and juniper give a clean aromatic heart, and amber wood, tonka bean and cedar leave a smooth, modern trail.
yal-y.short: A fresh aromatic for men: apple, ginger and bergamot, sage and juniper, on amber wood, tonka and cedar.
yal-y.insp: Y Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent.
yal-y.wear: Versatile and modern. For the office, daytime and evenings out.

jazeera-magic.name: Jazeera Magic
jazeera-magic.desc: Jazeera Magic is a sweet, enchanting oriental. Juicy fruits and saffron open over a soft floral heart of rose and jasmine, and warm amber, vanilla and musk give it a smooth, lingering trail.
jazeera-magic.short: A sweet, enchanting oriental: fruits and saffron over rose and jasmine, on amber, vanilla and musk.
jazeera-magic.wear: Warm and inviting. For evenings, celebrations and cooler months.

ice-land.name: Ice Land
ice-land.desc:
Pure freshness, inspired by the Arctic. Experience the refreshing elegance of Ice Land, a clean and sophisticated fragrance crafted for those who appreciate freshness that lasts. Its crisp, airy notes create an invigorating scent journey that keeps you feeling confident throughout the day.

  • Extrait de Parfum concentration
  • Clean and refreshing fragrance
  • Long lasting: up to 7 hours
  • Perfect for daily wear
  • Premium 50 ml bottle

Feel the cool. Wear the freshness.
ice-land.short: A clean, crisp Extrait de Parfum inspired by the Arctic, lasting up to 7 hours.
ice-land.insp: The Arctic: cold air, clean ice and endless freshness.
ice-land.wear: Perfect for daily wear. Spray on the neck and wrists in the morning; it lasts up to 7 hours.

fakhir-attar.name: Fakhir Attar
fakhir-attar.desc:
Step into a world of timeless elegance with Fakhir Attar, a luxurious concentrated perfume oil crafted for those who appreciate sophistication, depth and lasting impressions. Inspired by the richness of traditional perfumery and blended with modern refinement, this premium attar delivers a smooth, captivating fragrance from the very first drop.

Opening with refreshing citrus and marine accords, the fragrance evolves into a warm floral heart before settling into a rich woody base that feels both powerful and elegant.

Formulated with a high oil concentration, Fakhir Attar lasts up to 7 hours. The bottle’s premium golden detailing reflects the royal essence of the fragrance within.

Product highlights

  • Premium long-lasting attar oil, alcohol-free
  • Lasts up to 7 hours
  • Rich oriental and woody fragrance
  • For men and women
  • Ideal for daily wear and special occasions
fakhir-attar.short: An alcohol-free attar: lemon and marine accords, saffron and rose, on deep sandalwood. Lasts up to 7 hours.
fakhir-attar.insp: The richness of traditional attar perfumery, blended with modern refinement.
fakhir-attar.wear: Apply a small amount on pulse points: neck, wrists and behind the ears. For best results, apply on moisturised skin. Perfect for daily wear, festive occasions and prayers.

saudagar-20ml-x-4-piece-perfume-collecti.name: Saudagar 4-Piece Perfume Collection
saudagar-20ml-x-4-piece-perfume-collecti.desc:
Discover the perfect blend of elegance, freshness and long-lasting fragrance with the Saudagar Perfume Collection: 4 bottles of 20 ml (80 ml in all).

This premium set is crafted for those who love to carry multiple signature scents for different moods and occasions. Each bottle delivers a unique fragrance experience, from refreshing and energetic notes to deep, rich and luxurious oud-based aromas.

Fragrances included

  • Savage: bold, fresh and confident
  • Hawas Ice: cool, clean and refreshing
  • AM Oud: warm, woody and royal
  • Purple Oud: rich, intense and long-lasting
saudagar-20ml-x-4-piece-perfume-collecti.short: Four 20 ml Saudagar perfumes (Savage, Hawas Ice, AM Oud and Purple Oud): fresh to deep oud in one set.
saudagar-20ml-x-4-piece-perfume-collecti.insp: Four signature moods in one set: two fresh, two oud.
saudagar-20ml-x-4-piece-perfume-collecti.wear: Carry the set and switch by mood: Savage or Hawas Ice for fresh daytime wear, AM Oud or Purple Oud for evenings.

black-code-perfume.name: Black Code
black-code-perfume.desc:
Bold. Mysterious. Unforgettable.

Saudagar Black Code is a deep, enigmatic fragrance crafted for evenings filled with confidence and charm. It opens with the fresh, natural feel of aromatic green leaves and a clean water accord, creating a cool and subtle first impression.

At the heart lies a warm, golden layer of amber, giving the scent a sensual glow that becomes richer as it settles on the skin. The fragrance finally rests on a dark, earthy base of aged wood, bark and tanned grasses, leaving behind a smooth, mysterious trail that lingers long after you’ve left the room.

Perfect for date nights, dinners, late outings and cool-weather evenings, Black Code performs beautifully in autumn and winter, where its warm amber tones shine through the cold air.

A fragrance made for those who want to be remembered, not just noticed.
black-code-perfume.short: A deep, enigmatic evening scent: green leaves and a clean water accord over golden amber, on aged wood and bark.
black-code-perfume.insp: A Saudagar original, made for those who want to be remembered, not just noticed.
black-code-perfume.wear: For date nights, dinners, late outings and cool-weather evenings. Two sprays on the neck and chest.

ocean-blue-perfume.name: Ocean Blue
ocean-blue-perfume.desc:
Saudagar Ocean Blue is a refreshing everyday fragrance designed for those who love staying clean, confident and full of energy. It opens with a bright splash of cool mint, crisp green apple and Sicilian bergamot, giving an instant wave of freshness.

As the scent settles, warm tonka bean, smooth ambroxan, geranium and musk create a modern, soft heart that feels both comforting and stylish. Finally, the fragrance dries down into a long-lasting blend of vanilla, vetiver, Virginian and Atlas cedar and oakmoss, leaving a warm and memorable trail.

Perfect for the office, college, outdoors or daily wear, Saudagar Ocean Blue is your go-to scent for every moment. Fresh, cool and versatile: a fragrance that moves with you.
ocean-blue-perfume.short: A fresh everyday scent: cool mint, green apple and Sicilian bergamot over tonka and ambroxan, on vanilla and cedar.
ocean-blue-perfume.insp: A Saudagar original for those who love staying clean, confident and full of energy.
ocean-blue-perfume.wear: Your go-to for the office, college, outdoors and daily wear. Spray on the neck and wrists.

white-code-perfume.name: White Code
white-code-perfume.desc:
Soft. Elegant. Irresistibly feminine.

Saudagar White Code is a captivating fruity-floral fragrance created for moments when you want to feel delicate, graceful and beautifully confident. It opens with the juicy sweetness of peach, the sparkle of raspberry and a soft touch of pink peppercorn, giving a bright and flirty first impression.

At its heart blooms an elegant bouquet of velvety rose, pure jasmine and golden mimosa, adding sophistication and timeless charm. As it settles, the fragrance melts into a warm, comforting base of creamy vanilla and rich honey, leaving a soft, luxurious trail that feels both romantic and soothing.

Perfect for special occasions, date nights, celebrations or any moment you want to feel your most elegant.

A fragrance made for those who love to shine with quiet luxury.
white-code-perfume.short: A graceful fruity floral: peach, raspberry and pink peppercorn over rose, jasmine and mimosa, on vanilla and honey.
white-code-perfume.insp: A Saudagar original, made for those who love to shine with quiet luxury.
white-code-perfume.wear: For special occasions, date nights and celebrations. Spray on the wrists and neck.

blue-musk.name: Blue Musk
blue-musk.desc: Blue Musk is a clean, fresh musk with a cool blue twist. Bergamot and aquatic notes open brightly, soft lavender and white flowers form the heart, and a smooth base of white musk and light woods keeps it fresh all day.
blue-musk.short: A clean, fresh musk: bergamot and aquatic notes over lavender and white flowers, on white musk and light woods.
blue-musk.insp: The fresh, clean feeling of blue musk.
blue-musk.wear: Easy and everyday. Wear it to work, college and on warm days.

forest-jasmine.name: Forest Jasmine
forest-jasmine.desc: Forest Jasmine is a lush floral perfume built around fresh jasmine blossoms. Green leaves give a dewy opening, a rich heart of jasmine sambac blooms, and soft sandalwood with musk keeps it warm and lasting.
forest-jasmine.short: Fresh jasmine blossoms with dewy green leaves, on soft sandalwood and musk.
forest-jasmine.insp: Jasmine blooming in a green forest after rain.
forest-jasmine.wear: Graceful and fresh. For daily wear, temple visits and festive mornings.

javadhu.name: Javadhu
javadhu.desc: Javadhu is a traditional South Indian perfume, rich and powdery. Its warm, musky heart is blended with soft florals and creamy sandalwood, the scent long used in temples, weddings and festivals.
javadhu.short: A traditional South Indian javadhu: warm, powdery musk with soft florals and creamy sandalwood.
javadhu.insp: Javadhu, the traditional musk of South Indian temples and festivals.
javadhu.wear: Apply a little to the wrists and neck. Perfect for pooja, temple visits, weddings and festivals.

kewda.name: Kewda
kewda.desc: Kewda captures the sweet, green and honeyed scent of the screwpine flower, a classic of Indian perfumery. Fresh and floral at first, it settles on a soft, musky base.
kewda.short: The sweet, green, honeyed scent of the kewda (screwpine) flower, on soft musk.
kewda.insp: Kewda, the screwpine flower treasured in Indian perfumery.
kewda.wear: Fresh and traditional. For summer days, festivals and daily wear.

paarijatham.name: Paarijatham
paarijatham.desc: Paarijatham captures the night-flowering jasmine, the delicate white-and-orange blossom offered in prayer. Honeyed and gently sweet, it rests on soft musk and sandalwood.
paarijatham.short: The honeyed, delicate scent of night-flowering jasmine (paarijatham), on soft musk and sandalwood.
paarijatham.insp: The paarijatham blossom, offered in prayer at dawn.
paarijatham.wear: Gentle and serene. For prayer, temple visits and calm days.

pure-champa.name: Pure Champa
pure-champa.desc: Pure Champa celebrates the golden champaca flower: creamy, rich and gently fruity. Its warm floral heart sits on sandalwood and soft resins, the classic champa scent of Indian homes and temples.
pure-champa.short: The creamy, golden champaca flower on sandalwood and soft resins.
pure-champa.insp: Champa, the golden champaca flower of Indian homes and temples.
pure-champa.wear: Warm and soothing. For pooja, festivals and relaxed evenings.

pure-rose.name: Pure Rose
pure-rose.desc: Pure Rose is a true rose perfume: fresh petals at first, a rich and velvety rose heart, and a soft musky finish. Simple, classic and romantic.
pure-rose.short: A true, velvety rose from fresh petals to a soft musky finish.
pure-rose.insp: The classic rose of Indian gardens and celebrations.
pure-rose.wear: Romantic and classic. For weddings, festivals and everyday elegance.

rajani-gandha.name: Rajani Gandha
rajani-gandha.desc: Rajani Gandha captures the tuberose, the night-blooming flower whose name means "fragrance of the night". Creamy, heady and intensely floral, it settles on soft musk and sandalwood.
rajani-gandha.short: Creamy, heady tuberose, the "fragrance of the night", on soft musk and sandalwood.
rajani-gandha.wear: Rich and romantic. For evenings, weddings and festivals.
